name: Fairness-Aware AI-Generated Face Detection
description: Detect whether a facial image is real or AI-generated (binary classification) while ensuring fairness across demographic groups defined by skin tone, gender, and age. The task also evaluates robustness under various post-processing conditions and cross-domain scenarios.

cr:input.name: Input Dataset
cr:input.description: The input dataset contains facial image metadata with columns: 'id', 'pred', 'skin_tone', 'gender'. Example: id='sample_000', pred='value_0', skin_tone='value_0', gender='value_0'.
cr:input.contentUrl: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset source URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The output predictions include columns: 'id', 'pred', 'skin_tone', 'gender', 'age'. Example: id='sample_000', pred='value_0', skin_tone='value_0', gender='value_0', age=0.

field.name: id
field.description: Unique identifier for each sample. Example: 'sample_000'.

field.name: pred
field.description: Predicted value for the sample. Example: 'value_0'.

field.name: skin_tone
field.description: Skin tone category for the sample. Example: 'value_0'.

field.name: gender
field.description: Gender category for the sample. Example: 'value_0'.

field.name: age
field.description: Predicted age for the sample. Example: 0.

cr:evaluation.notes: Metrics include utility metrics such as AUC, ACC, AP, and EER, as well as fairness metrics (FPR, TPR, FEO, FMEO, FDP, FOAE, FIND). Fairness metrics are placeholders and require subgroup information for computation.
